name: Daily Revenue Rollup
notes: Feeds the executive dashboard and finance team daily standup. Any SLA breach triggers a P1 incident. The board_metrics dependency is reviewed at 08:00 UTC each morning. Source-data corruption (checksum failures) must always be escalated immediately — auto-retry on corrupted data is not permitted.

name: CRM Customer Sync
notes: Salesforce API occasionally returns intermittent 504s during high-load periods. Pipeline has historically self-resolved within 4 retries. CRM engineering team is aware and working on an upstream fix.

name: Market Data Feed (Legacy)
notes: Fully migrated to pl_market_feed_v2. This pipeline is in wind-down. Failures should NOT be actioned — the pipeline will be decommissioned at end_of_life_date.

name: Web Analytics Aggregation
notes: Row counts vary significantly with traffic patterns. No hard SLA. Downstream dashboard has a 4-hour staleness tolerance — a single failed run is covered by the next scheduled execution 2 hours later.

name: Daily Risk Score Computation
notes: Risk scores feed the trading limits engine, which has a regulatory requirement to refresh before market open at 07:00 UTC. A persistent upstream outage that cannot refresh scores before the 07:00 UTC gate must be escalated immediately rather than left to exhaust retries.

name: Client Report PDF Export
notes: Generates PDF reports for the client portal. If the SLA window has already passed, reports are regenerated on-demand by the BI team. Do not retry after SLA has been missed — the BI team will handle it.
